youtube.description: 第34天早上，她和知遠帶著地契與謄本走進江慕白的事務所。江慕白看著桌上的東西，眼鏡滑下來：地一直登記在老太太名下？她說：你早知道。他推說只替沈家寫合約、照建邦的意思寫，地在誰名下與他無關；她說老太太的地建邦賣不了，他寫的時候就知道。江慕白要先問過委託人，約下午三點。中午，建邦到盛通頂樓談三億的違約金；周懷安說照合約用印違約金就不存在，地的事也不用怕：老太太的戶籍下週除掉，地自然歸繼承。建邦說失蹤宣告要好幾年，周懷安只說：我有辦法。下午三點，她坐回江慕白對面，先按下手機錄音。江慕白說合約一個字都不改，她要看他的顧問契約；他自己從櫃子拿出兩份攤在桌上，知遠翻到第二份：委任人是盛通。江慕白順口一句「盛通給的也不多」，她把手機轉向他：剛才那句都錄著。江慕白低下頭，摘下眼鏡：用印定了，明天早上十點，在大廳。

data.prompt: In the same lawyer's office high in the new business district at three in the afternoon, the light through the big window lower, slanting and colder, the glass towers outside reflecting the winter sun, the desk lamp on, the camera low on the desk beside a black phone lying flat, its screen out of view, looking up at the man on screen right. At the left edge of the foreground a young woman's moon-white cuff and the silver ring on her left hand rest on the desk, out of focus. Jiang Mubai behind the desk, sweat at his temple, not smiling; behind him, out of focus, Shen Zhiyuan in his charcoal overcoat by the window, the two stapled sets at the desk corner, the tower outside. He takes off his gold-rimmed glasses with his right hand, holds them by one arm and raises his eyes to the young woman. Jiang Mubai speaks a Mandarin line, his lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, very low. The others keep their mouths closed.
